note: WO-057: every fill an independent reviewer (who read only the persona, each posting's location and the fills, never the code) judged wrong or not settled on sealed sample F (captured by CI run 39436937169, 2026-10-20, scored once on trunk 7bdeaa63, now spent). Each must no longer get the answer it got. Labels are as the reviewer saw them (whitespace collapsed, at most 700 characters); options are the first 60.

cases.label: Do you have any relatives or contacts with whom you have personal or social relationships working at Eikon Therapeutics?
cases.why: Persona says no relatives at employers but says nothing about personal or social contacts working there.

cases.label: Source
cases.why: The applicant heard via the company website, not a university career page; 'Other' fits.

cases.label: How many years of professional experience do you working in UX/UI design?
options: More than 1 year and less than 3 years
More than 3 years and less than 5 years
More than 5 years and less than 7 years
cases.was: More than 1 year and less than 3 years
cases.why: Persona has no UX/UI design experience (3 years as a Data Analyst); the 1-3 years figure is invented.

cases.label: This position requires current U. S. citizenship in order to achieve and maintain a security clearance. Are you currently a U. S. citizen?
cases.why: Applicant is a US citizen; answer should be Yes.

cases.label: This position is HYBRID in Dayton, Ohio. Are you willing to travel to Dayton at least 2 days per week?
cases.why: Applicant lives in Chicago and is on-site only where they live; general travel willingness does not cover commuting to Dayton 2 days a week.

cases.label: Where are you staying in Hyderabad? Mention full address.
cases.why: Applicant does not stay in Hyderabad; giving the Chicago address answers a different question.

cases.label: What date are you available to begin employment (Month and Year)
cases.why: Field asks for a start month and year; '2 weeks' is a duration, not a date (should be e.g. November 2026).

cases.label: Are you currently employed by, or act as a representative of a political party in the US?
cases.why: Employer list rules out employment by a party, but nothing says whether they act as a political party representative.

cases.label: Work authorization
options: I am authorized to work in the country due to my nationality
I am authorized to work in the country based on a valid work permit and do not need a company to sponsor my visa
I am authorized to work in the country based on a valid work permit which needs to be sponsored by the company I work for
I am not authorized to work in the country and need visa support
cases.was: I am authorized to work in the country based on a valid work permit and do not need a company to sponsor my visa
cases.why: Applicant is a US citizen, so the right option is 'authorized due to my nationality', not a work permit.
